Santiago Bernabéu 3D Experience — asset acknowledgements

Potsdamer Platz, 1K HDR environment
Author: Greg Zaal / Poly Haven
Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/potsdamer_platz
License: CC0 1.0, https://polyhaven.com/license
Used as a lighting and reflection environment, not a background photograph.

All stadium geometry, urban context, grass/markings, signs, seats, and interface
are generated locally by the source code. No official club assets are included.

Three.js: MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/LICENSE
GSAP: Standard License, https://gsap.com/standard-license
Vite: MIT, https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/LICENSE
Installed package license files remain in node_modules.
